title: Weakness and Poorness
statementMd:
You are given a sequence of n integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$.

Determine a real number $*x*$ such that the *weakness* of the sequence $*a*_{1} - *x*, *a*_{2} - *x*, ..., *a*_{*n*} - *x*$ is as small as possible.

The *weakness* of a sequence is defined as the maximum value of the *poorness* over all segments (contiguous subsequences) of a sequence.

The *poorness* of a segment is defined as the absolute value of sum of the elements of segment.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$), the length of a sequence.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($|*a*_{*i*}| ≤ 10 000$).

## Output

Output a real number denoting the minimum possible *weakness* of $*a*_{1} - *x*, *a*_{2} - *x*, ..., *a*_{*n*} - *x*$. Your answer will be considered correct if its relative or absolute error doesn't exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

## Note

For the first case, the optimal value of $*x*$ is $2$ so the sequence becomes $- 1$, $0$, $1$ and the max poorness occurs at the segment "-1" or segment "1". The poorness value (answer) equals to $1$ in this case.

For the second sample the optimal value of $*x*$ is $2.5$ so the sequence becomes $- 1.5,  - 0.5, 0.5, 1.5$ and the max poorness occurs on segment "-1.5 -0.5" or "0.5 1.5". The poorness value (answer) equals to $2$ in this case.
statementZhMd:
给定一个由 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ 组成的整数序列。

请确定一个实数 $*x*$，使序列 $*a*_{1} - *x*, *a*_{2} - *x*, ..., *a*_{*n*} - *x*$ 的*弱度*尽可能小。

一个序列的*弱度*定义为其所有区间（连续子序列）的*贫困度*中的最大值。

一个区间的*贫困度*定义为该区间所有元素之和的绝对值。

## 输入

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$），表示序列的长度。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$|*a*_{*i*}| ≤ 10 000$）。

## 输出

输出一个实数，表示 $*a*_{1} - *x*, *a*_{2} - *x*, ..., *a*_{*n*} - *x*$ 的最小可能弱度。如果你的答案的相对误差或绝对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则视为正确。

## 说明

对于第一组数据，$*x*$ 的最优值为 $2$，因此序列变为 $- 1$、$0$、$1$，最大贫困度出现在区间 "-1" 或区间 "1" 上。这种情况下的贫困度（答案）等于 $1$。

对于第二个样例，$*x*$ 的最优值为 $2.5$，因此序列变为 $- 1.5,  - 0.5, 0.5, 1.5$，最大贫困度出现在区间 "-1.5 -0.5" 或 "0.5 1.5" 上。这种情况下的贫困度（答案）等于 $2$。
